rationale_evidence.statement: All 27 underlying findings are consolidated into five systemic themes, each with a diagnosed root cause: (1) source-to-synthesis compression -- root: ratification recorded selections without loss-ledgers, part architectural (5 load-bearing members) and part merely explanatory; (2) transformation semantics under-specified (eta, ladder transition calculus, policy dynamics plus genesis, action semantics, adjudication, Learn/F) -- one root: the corpus formalized states/structures/boundaries but never the transformations between them, classified research; (3) identity/equality semantics (evidence equivalence, frame equivalence, requirement identity, K_t equality) -- one root: no identity calculus exists, classified research, with I-5 and replay conditionally defined until it does; (4) authorization/governance resolution semantics (the PF-9 governance-algebra core plus un-ratified escalation/AI-non-override plus AF-F-15's adjudication gap) -- one root: L5 (practice-layer) governance is richer than L2's (ratified-layer) governance surface, classified architectural-candidate; (5) the L2-to-L3/L4 realization gap -- standing and honest, no new members, characterized as a conformance profile rather than a defect.

rationale_evidence.statement: Documents that the earlier historical KnowledgeOS work explored a much broader range of mathematical frameworks than the current v0.2 architecture retains: measure theory, probability, entropy, KL divergence, Wasserstein/epistemic distance, topology, knowledge-density/flux, a knowledge-space Omega, and continuous evolution equations -- for example a proposed continuity-style PDE, partial(k)/partial(t) + div(J) = S - D, with quantities like coverage, uncertainty, information gain, stability, and epistemic distance. States that later falsification/archaeology correctly concluded these should not automatically become the KnowledgeOS mathematical foundation, and explicitly frames the current mathematical audit (GN-46, S1326) as doing exactly this same separation work: distinguishing interesting mathematical frameworks from mathematics actually established by the ratified architecture -- consistent with GN-46's own finding that no metric/measure/entropy/topology claim appears anywhere in the ratified material.
